gates.summary: Baseline provenance is being reconciled against the declared Git tree and deployed binary identity remains unresolved.
Specification requires corrected activation, transcript, manifest and differential-vector evidence before satisfaction.
V2 primitives are deliberately unreachable from HF17 and are not integrated with block parsing, connect/disconnect, templates, or coinbase validation.
No owner-approved risk budget or optimized multi-hardware admission/committee parameter set exists.
Empty-set policy and emission accounting require an explicit tokenomics decision.
The scoped payment-proof candidate has not received independent cryptographic review.
The journal primitive is not connected to same-transaction LMDB state, crash recovery, migration, or pruned validation.
Probe, P2P, RPC, admission-cache, and DNS-race protections are not connected to live handlers or sustained-load tests.
No final-protocol four-node enrollment, receipt, payout, partition, restart, and deep-reorg run exists.
Maturity, spend, recipient receipt, rescan, repeated output uniqueness, and reward-fork replacement are not proven on final binaries.
Linux, Docker, macOS Apple Silicon, checksums, source-to-binary identity, and dependency manifest are incomplete.
No independent adversarial review of the integrated hardened protocol exists.
Genesis, activation height, final limits, parameters, state schema, and release binaries remain unset; the observed activation block is postactivation evidence.
